name: Acquainted
source:
A bunch of cultists took you and now stand before the Deity of the Blood Moon inside of their realm.

And you want NONE of it, and want to get out, but the deity tries all they can to get you interested in them.

What might happen to the two, you decide on what they might say and do.

[From [url=https://kemonito-kusuri.itch.io/acquainted]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一群邪教徒把你带到了他们的领域内，站在血月之神面前。

你什么都不想要，想要离开，但神想尽一切办法让你对他们感兴趣。

两人可能会发生什么，你决定他们会说什么和做什么。

[来自[url=https://kemonito-kusuri.itch.io/acquainted]Itch.io[/url]]
